text: Wheels Up: Airplane Travel Course Traveling with kids can be one of life’s great adventures or total chaos before you even step out the door. What makes all the difference? Being well-prepared. With this online mini course and workbook, we’ll walk you through everything you need to know -- from arriving at the airport to getting your rental car -- so that you are ready for anything this trip throws at you (except for lost luggage). Wheels Up will teach you how to travel with kids and car seats like the total pro you are. $39.00 USD

Building Your Car Seat Confidence: VIP Let’s get real: car seats are complicated. The anxiety that comes from harnessing your child in for the first time is another level of stress. And we totally get it. You want to do everything in your power to keep your child safe. In this video-based online course, we’ll teach you everything you need to know from harnessing to installation and everything in between. We’re happy to be your one-stop for all things car seats including video demos, problem-solving tips, answers to the most frequently asked car seat safety questions and a customizable workbook to support your journey. We’ll help you get car seat confident. $179.00 USD
